title: Code of Virginia, Title 51.1 (Pensions, Benefits, and Retirement), Chapter 1 - Virginia Retirement System
verified_how: fetched https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title51.1/chapter1/ (HTTP 200): heading 'Chapter 1. Virginia Retirement System', article heading 'Article 1.1. General Provisions' listing s 51.1-124.1 (Virginia Retirement System established), 51.1-124.2 (Virginia Supplemental Retirement System continued as Virginia Retirement System), 51.1-124.3 (Definitions), 51.1-124.4, 51.1-124.5, 51.1-124.6 and 51.1-124.7 onward; s 51.1-100 in Article 1 is marked 'Repealed'. I also fetched the title index https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title51.1/ (HTTP 200), which gives 'Chapter 1 Virginia Retirement System [ss 51.1-100 through 51.1-169]'. Currency: the register's own 2026 Updates page (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacodeupdates/) states 'this is a list of updated sections that took effect on July 1, 2026, unless otherwise noted', so the online Code reflects the 2026 session. The site marks future text as '(Effective <date>)' and dead text as 'Repealed', and the cited provisions carry neither marker. Note that article-level URLs such as /vacode/title40.1/chapter3/article2/ return HTTP 200 with an EMPTY content pane, so the citable register page for an article is its chapter page, which prints the article heading and its section list.
notes: Old-age, survivors and disability insurance itself is federal (42 U.S.C. ch. 7); this is the state and local public-employee pension scheme and the principal Virginia pension statute. Title 51.1 ch. 7 (Federal Social Security for State and Local Employees, ss 51.1-700 to 51.1-707) and ch. 8 (Local Retirement Systems) were seen on the same title index.
